reference.enthalpy_locator: WebBook Shomate H, common elemental formation reference

phase_transition.interpretation: Difference of rounded source entries, not experimental uncertainty. Transition entropy is derived as L/T from phase equilibrium; original rounded entropy entries remain independently recorded.

caloric_representation.definition: Integrate each original Shomate Cp; anchor alpha h/S to 298.15 K reference, join beta h by original table latent heat and beta S by L/T. No modification to Cp coefficients. Constant shifts from the original fitted h/S are explicitly reported; this derived representation enforces phase equilibrium, not exact reproduction of all printed thermochemical data.
caloric_representation.pressure_scope: Only source standard pressure; no molar-volume, thermal expansion, stress or pressure-shift prediction
caloric_representation.other_phase_scope: Restricted below 1100 K; no tridymite, cristobalite or melt conversion

virtual_calorimeter.definition: Stress-free constant standard-pressure pure-quartz body; dH/dt=Q includes enthalpy storage, not fixed-volume internal energy. Ideal instantaneous reversible alpha-beta partition, no hysteresis or rate claim.
